name: Instapage
tagline: Instapage is a landing page platform for building, A/B testing, and personalizing post-click experiences for paid campaigns. Marketing teams can create dedicated pages without developer help, then improve performance through built-in experimentation and heatmap analytics. It connects to Google Ads, Meta, and most major ad platforms.
